integrity: An explicit proof and standalone finite regression checker are supplied. The checks are corroborative and do not substitute for the quantified proof.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two KD45 agents, a symmetric strong-disagreement bundle, finite fixed propositional vocabulary, and depth-one equivalence; arbitrary-depth classification and independent priority adjudication not claimed. The potentially close 2017 paper was accessible only through its abstract.
title: Exact depth-one semantic quotient for two-agent belief disagreement
